title: Grandpa and Grandma’s Love Story
synopsis: What’s the secret to a long-lasting marriage? Find out what Little Zhang has observed in his grandparents’ more than 60-year marriage.

fullText.simplified:
爷爷奶奶的爱情故事

    一直在外地上班的小张，回老家工作了。为了欢迎小张，朋友们和小张周末晚上一起去了KTV唱歌。当晚，大家都很高兴。他们唱啊、跳啊、聊啊、特别高兴。
    “你们知道吗？小刘离婚啦！”、“什么？她不是刚结婚三个月吗？你这消息准吗？”、“当然啦，她朋友圈都发了，一看你就不看朋友圈。”……小王爆出的“八卦”让大家把话题转到了感情上。不聊不知道，一聊吓一跳！原来身边有很多朋友都有感情问题。大家聊着聊着情绪都不太好了。看到大家情绪的变化，小张说：“我给大家讲讲我爷爷奶奶的爱情故事吧。给大家点儿信心。要相信爱情！”于是所有人都安静了下来，开始听小张讲故事。
    小张说：“我爷爷今年82岁，奶奶今年85岁，他们已经结婚60多年了。他俩的爱情故事我们从小听到大。奶奶和爷爷结婚的时候，她已经21岁了。在那个很早就结婚的年代，21岁的奶奶算是个‘老姑娘’了。左邻右舍都觉得奶奶嫁不出去了，连她的父母也那么认为，奶奶的婚事把她的父母急得吃不下饭，睡不着觉。
    不过奶奶有自己的想法。她虽然没上过学，但是她一直坚持要跟喜欢的人结婚，不会为了结婚而结婚。奶奶遇到爷爷很有戏剧性。当时，爷爷的老家发大水，家人都去世了，他一个人逃难来到了奶奶的村子。由于太饿了，爷爷晕倒在了村口。奶奶正好路过，救了爷爷。奶奶把爷爷背回家，给他喂水喂饭。爷爷好了以后，就留在了奶奶家，帮他们干活。爷爷能吃苦，干活很卖力，而且长得还不错。慢慢地，奶奶喜欢上了爷爷。终于有一天，奶奶跟爷爷表白了。她问爷爷愿意不愿意跟她结婚。爷爷点头同意了。
    就这样，奶奶和爷爷结婚了。他们还是‘姐弟恋’哦！结婚后的生活仍然很平淡，奶奶在家照顾老人孩子，爷爷种地，卖蔬菜水果赚钱。”
    小张说到这儿，小王问他：“你爷爷奶奶不吵架吗？结婚60多年了，听起来生活平淡，没什么激情，他们是怎么过下去的呢？”“你这个问题问得好，我也这么问过他们。我奶奶说过日子没有不吵架的，关键是怎么相处！我爷爷内向，不爱说话，是个‘闷葫芦’；我奶奶外向，热情，是个‘大嗓门’。遇到问题了，我爷爷只会蹲在地上抽烟，一声也不吭。我奶奶知道他的性格，也不着急，吃饭时会准备爷爷爱喝的酒，多炒两个菜，边吃边说，问题很快就解决了。”
    小张接着说：“所以他们在一起60多年，没有多浪漫的事情，却有最温暖的时光。我从他们的爱情里学会了包容，学会了换位思考，也学会了关心理解对方。现在年轻人的感情，有些浮躁，追求浪漫，金钱，还有些自私，总是希望别人对自己更好，一吵架就没完没了。当然长不了。”
    朋友们听了小张爷爷奶奶的故事，都沉默不说话了。小张觉得他们应该是听懂了，是在反思和思考。

爺爺奶奶的愛情故事

    一直在外地上班的小張，回老家工作了。為了歡迎小張，朋友們和小張週末晚上一起去了KTV唱歌。當晚，大家都很高興。他們唱啊、跳啊、聊啊、特別高興。
    “你們知道嗎？小劉離婚啦！”、“什麼？她不是剛結婚三個月嗎？你這消息準嗎？”、“當然啦，她朋友圈都發了，一看你就不看朋友圈。”……小王爆出的“八卦”讓大家把話題轉到了感情上。不聊不知道，一聊嚇一跳！原來身邊有很多朋友都有感情問題。大家聊著聊著情緒都不太好了。看到大家情緒的變化，小張說：“我給大家講講我爺爺奶奶的愛情故事吧。給大家點兒信心。要相信愛情！”於是所有人都安靜了下來，開始聽小張講故事。
    小張說：“我爺爺今年82歲，奶奶今年85歲，他們已經結婚60多年了。他倆的愛情故事我們從小聽到大。奶奶和爺爺結婚的時候，她已經21歲了。在那個很早就結婚的年代，21歲的奶奶算是個‘老姑娘’了。左鄰右舍都覺得奶奶嫁不出去了，連她的父母也那麼認為，奶奶的婚事把她的父母急得吃不下飯，睡不著覺。
    不過奶奶有自己的想法。她雖然沒上過學，但是她一直堅持要跟喜歡的人結婚，不會為了結婚而結婚。奶奶遇到爺爺很有戲劇性。當時，爺爺的老家發大水，家人都去世了，他一個人逃難來到了奶奶的村子。由於太餓了，爺爺暈倒在了村口。奶奶正好路過，救了爺爺。奶奶把爺爺背回家，給他餵水餵飯。爺爺好了以後，就留在了奶奶家，幫他們幹活。爺爺能吃苦，幹活很賣力，而且長得還不錯。慢慢地，奶奶喜歡上了爺爺。終於有一天，奶奶跟爺爺表白了。她問爺爺願意不願意跟她結婚。爺爺點頭同意了。
    就這樣，奶奶和爺爺結婚了。他們還是‘姐弟戀’哦！結婚後的生活仍然很平淡，奶奶在家照顧老人孩子，爺爺種地，賣蔬菜水果賺錢。”
    小張說到這兒，小王問他：“你爺爺奶奶不吵架嗎？結婚60多年了，聽起來生活平淡，沒什麼激情，他們是怎麼過下去的呢？”“你這個問題問得好，我也這麼問過他們。我奶奶說過日子沒有不吵架的，關鍵是怎麼相處！我爺爺內向，不愛說話，是個‘悶葫蘆’；我奶奶外向，熱情，是個‘大嗓門’。遇到問題了，我爺爺只會蹲在地上抽煙，一聲也不吭。我奶奶知道他的性格，也不著急，吃飯時會準備爺爺愛喝的酒，多炒兩個菜，邊吃邊說，問題很快就解決了。”
    小張接著說：“所以他們在一起60多年，沒有多浪漫的事情，卻有最溫暖的時光。我從他們的愛情裡學會了包容，學會了換位思考，也學會了關心理解對方。現在年輕人的感情，有些浮躁，追求浪漫，金錢，還有些自私，總是希望別人對自己更好，一吵架就沒完沒了。當然長不了。”
    朋友們聽了小張爺爺奶奶的故事，都沉默不說話了。小張覺得他們應該是聽懂了，是在反思和思考。

sentences.traditional: 結婚後的生活仍然很平淡，奶奶在家照顧老人孩子，
sentences.pinyin: jié hūn hòu de shēng huó réng rán hěn píng dàn nǎi nai zài jiā zhào gù lǎo rén hái zi
sentences.english: Just like that, my grandma and grandpa got married. They’re also a couple where the girl is older than the guy!

sentences.simplified: 爷爷种地，卖蔬菜水果赚钱。”
sentences.traditional: 爺爺種地，賣蔬菜水果賺錢。”
sentences.pinyin: yé ye zhòng dì mài shū cài shuǐ guǒ zhuàn qián
sentences.english: After marriage, their life remained ordinary. My grandma stayed at home and took care of her elderly parents and the children.
My grandpa farmed and sold vegetables and fruits for money.”

sentences.simplified: 小张说到这儿，小王问他：“你爷爷奶奶不吵架吗？
sentences.traditional: 小張說到這兒，小王問他：“你爺爺奶奶不吵架嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo zhāng shuō dào zhè‘r xiǎo wáng wèn tā nǐ yé ye nǎi nai bù chǎo jià ma

sentences.simplified: 结婚60多年了，听起来生活平淡，没什么激情，他们是怎么过下去的呢？
sentences.traditional: 結婚60多年了，聽起來生活平淡，沒什麼激情，他們是怎麼過下去的呢？
sentences.pinyin: jié hūn 2 duō nián le tīng qǐ lái shēng huó píng dàn méi shén me jī qíng tā men shì zěn me guò xià qù de ne
sentences.english: After Little Zhang said this, Little Wang asked him, “Do your grandpa and grandma not fight?

sentences.simplified: ”“你这个问题问得好，我也这么问过他们。
sentences.traditional: ”“你這個問題問得好，我也這麼問過他們。
sentences.pinyin: nǐ zhè ge wèn tí wèn de hǎo wǒ yě zhè me wèn guò tā men
sentences.english: Being married for over 60 years, it sounds like their life is quite ordinary and without much passion. How have they gotten through it?”

sentences.simplified: 我奶奶说过日子没有不吵架的，关键是怎么相处！
sentences.traditional: 我奶奶說過日子沒有不吵架的，關鍵是怎麼相處！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ nǎi nai shuō guò rì zi méi yǒu bù chǎo jià de guān jiàn shì zěn me xiāng chǔ
sentences.english: “That’s a good question. I had asked them the same thing.

sentences.simplified: 我爷爷内向，不爱说话，是个‘闷葫芦’；我奶奶外向，热情，是个‘大嗓门’。
sentences.traditional: 我爺爺內向，不愛說話，是個‘悶葫蘆’；我奶奶外向，熱情，是個‘大嗓門’。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ yé ye nèi xiàng bú ài shuō huà shì ge mèn hú lu wǒ nǎi nai wài xiàng rè qíng shì ge dà sǎng mén
sentences.english: My grandma said that there’s no such thing as going through life without fighting. What’s important is how you get along!

sentences.simplified: 遇到问题了，我爷爷只会蹲在地上抽烟，一声也不吭。
sentences.traditional: 遇到問題了，我爺爺只會蹲在地上抽煙，一聲也不吭。
sentences.pinyin: yù dào wèn tí le wǒ yé ye zhǐ huì dūn zài dì shang chōu yān yì shēng yě bù kēng
sentences.english: My grandpa is introverted, not talkative, and is like a “closed book”. My grandma is extroverted, enthusiastic, and has a “loud voice’”.

sentences.simplified: 我奶奶知道他的性格，也不着急，
sentences.traditional: 我奶奶知道他的性格，也不著急，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ nǎi nai zhī dào tā de xìng gé yě bù zháo jí
sentences.english: When they run into problems, my grandpa will just squat on the floor and smoke without saying a word.

sentences.simplified: 吃饭时会准备爷爷爱喝的酒，多炒两个菜，
sentences.traditional: 吃飯時會準備爺爺愛喝的酒，多炒兩個菜，
sentences.pinyin: chī fàn shí huì zhǔn bèi yé ye ài hē de jiǔ duō chǎo liǎng ge cài
sentences.english: My grandma knows his personality, so she doesn’t get anxious about it.

sentences.simplified: 边吃边说，问题很快就解决了。”
sentences.traditional: 邊吃邊說，問題很快就解決了。”
sentences.pinyin: biān chī biān shuō wèn tí hěn kuài jiù jiě jué le
sentences.english: During meals, she will prepare alcohol that my grandpa likes and make a few extra dishes.
They will talk things over while eating. Problems get worked out very quickly.”

sentences.simplified: 小张接着说：“所以他们在一起60多年，没有多浪漫的事情，却有最温暖的时光。
sentences.traditional: 小張接著說：“所以他們在一起60多年，沒有多浪漫的事情，卻有最溫暖的時光。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo zhāng jiē zhe shuō suǒ yǐ tā men zài yì qǐ 2 duō nián méi yǒu duō làng màn de shì qing què yǒu zuì wēn nuǎn de shí guāng

sentences.simplified: 我从他们的爱情里学会了包容，学会了换位思考，
sentences.traditional: 我從他們的愛情裡學會了包容，學會了換位思考，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ cóng tā men de ài qíng lǐ xué huì le bāo róng xué huì le huàn wèi sī kǎo
sentences.english: Little Zhang continued, “So, they have been together for over 60 years, without much romance, but with the warmest moments.

sentences.simplified: 也学会了关心理解对方。
sentences.traditional: 也學會了關心理解對方。
sentences.pinyin: yě xué huì le guān xīn lǐ jiě duì fāng
sentences.english: Through their love, I have learned how to be generous and forgiving, learned how to see things from someone else’s perspective, ..

sentences.simplified: 现在年轻人的感情，有些浮躁，追求浪漫，金钱，
sentences.traditional: 現在年輕人的感情，有些浮躁，追求浪漫，金錢，
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài nián qīng rén de gǎn qíng yǒu xiē fú zào zhuī qiú làng màn jīn qián
sentences.english: .. and also learned how to care for and understand another person.

sentences.simplified: 还有些自私，总是希望别人对自己更好，一吵架就没完没了。
sentences.traditional: 還有些自私，總是希望別人對自己更好，一吵架就沒完沒了。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu xiē zì sī zǒng shì xī wàng bié ren duì zì jǐ gèng hǎo yì chǎo jià jiù méi wán méi liǎo
sentences.english: Nowadays, young people’s relationships are quite impetuous, chasing romance and money.

sentences.simplified: 当然长不了。”
sentences.traditional: 當然長不了。”
sentences.pinyin: dāng rán cháng bù liǎo
sentences.english: They are also quite selfish, always wanting the other person to treat them better. When they fight, it never ends.
Of course, they can’t last long.”

sentences.simplified: 朋友们听了小张爷爷奶奶的故事，都沉默不说话了。
sentences.traditional: 朋友們聽了小張爺爺奶奶的故事，都沉默不說話了。
sentences.pinyin: péng you men tīng le xiǎo zhāng yé ye nǎi nai de gù shi dōu chén mò bù shuō huà le

sentences.simplified: 小张觉得他们应该是听懂了，是在反思和思考。
sentences.traditional: 小張覺得他們應該是聽懂了，是在反思和思考。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo zhāng jué de tā men yīng gāi shì tīng dǒng le shì zài fǎn sī hé sī kǎo
sentences.english: After the friends heard Little Zhang’s grandpa and grandma’s story, they all became silent.

sentence_translations: Grandpa and Grandma’s Love Story
Little Zhang, who had worked away from home for a long time, returned to his hometown to work.
In order to welcome Little Zhang, his friends took him to sing karaoke on a weekend night.
That night, everyone was very happy. They sang, danced, chatted, and were extremely happy.
“Did you know? Little Liu got divorced!”
“What? Didn’t she just get married three months ago? Is your information accurate?”
“Of course, she even posted it in her Wechat Moments. I can tell you don’t look at Wechat Moments.”
…The “gossip” revealed by Little Wang caused everyone to change the topic to relationships.
If this topic hadn’t been mentioned, no one would have known. But once mentioned, it was a shock!
It turned out that many people around them had relationship problems.
As they talked about this, everyone’s mood became worse.
Seeing the change in everyone’s mood, Little Zhang said, “Let me tell everyone about my grandma and grandpa’s love story.
It’ll give us all some confidence. We should believe in love.”
So, everyone quieted down and began to listen to Little Zhang tell his story.
Little Zhang said, “My grandpa is 82 years old, and my grandma is 85 years old. They have been married for over 60 years.
We grew up hearing their love story. When my grandma and grandpa got married, she was already 21 years old.
In that era where everyone married very young, my 21-year-old grandma was already considered a “spinster”.
The neighbors all thought that my grandma wouldn’t be able to get married, and even her parents felt that way.
My grandma’s marriage situation worried her parents so much that they couldn’t eat or sleep.
However, my grandma had her own ideas.
Even though she never went to school, she always insisted that she marry someone she liked.
She would not get married just for the sake of getting married.
The meeting between my grandma and grandpa was quite dramatic.
At that time, my grandpa’s hometown experienced a major flood, and his family all died. He fled to my grandma’s village alone.
My grandpa fainted at the entrance of the village because he was so hungry.
My grandma just happened to pass by, and she saved my grandpa.
My grandma carried my grandpa home and gave him food and water.
After my grandpa recovered, he stayed at my grandma’s house and did jobs for them.
My grandpa could bear hardship, and he worked hard. He was also pretty good-looking.
Slowly, my grandma came to like my grandpa. Finally, one day, my grandma confessed her feelings to my grandpa.
She asked my grandpa if he was willing to marry her. My grandpa nodded in agreement.
Just like that, my grandma and grandpa got married. They’re also a couple where the girl is older than the guy!
After marriage, their life remained ordinary. My grandma stayed at home and took care of her elderly parents and the children.
My grandpa farmed and sold vegetables and fruits for money.”
After Little Zhang said this, Little Wang asked him, “Do your grandpa and grandma not fight?
Being married for over 60 years, it sounds like their life is quite ordinary and without much passion. How have they gotten through it?”
“That’s a good question. I had asked them the same thing.
My grandma said that there’s no such thing as going through life without fighting. What’s important is how you get along!
My grandpa is introverted, not talkative, and is like a “closed book”. My grandma is extroverted, enthusiastic, and has a “loud voice’”.
When they run into problems, my grandpa will just squat on the floor and smoke without saying a word.
My grandma knows his personality, so she doesn’t get anxious about it.
During meals, she will prepare alcohol that my grandpa likes and make a few extra dishes.
They will talk things over while eating. Problems get worked out very quickly.”
Little Zhang continued, “So, they have been together for over 60 years, without much romance, but with the warmest moments.
Through their love, I have learned how to be generous and forgiving, learned how to see things from someone else’s perspective, ..
.. and also learned how to care for and understand another person.
Nowadays, young people’s relationships are quite impetuous, chasing romance and money.
They are also quite selfish, always wanting the other person to treat them better. When they fight, it never ends.
Of course, they can’t last long.”
After the friends heard Little Zhang’s grandpa and grandma’s story, they all became silent.
Little Zhang thought that they must have understood and were reflecting and contemplating.
